scripts.setup:venv: test -d Scripts/.venv || python3 -m venv Scripts/.venv && Scripts/.venv/bin/pip install -r Scripts/requirements.txt -r Scripts/requirements-dev.txt || Scripts/.venv/bin/pip install -r Scripts/requirements.txt -r Scripts/requirements-dev.txt -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple --trusted-host pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn
scripts.dev: npm run setup:venv && concurrently -n svc,fe -c blue,green "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: cd Service && npm install && cd ../Frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm run setup:venv && npm run setup:precommit
scripts.test: cd Service && npm test && cd ../Frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
scripts.test:frontend: cd Frontend && npx vue-tsc --noEmit && npm test
